entities.summary: Fabio Casadei Turroni is an Italian novelist, musicologist and journalist. Son of the painter Rino Casadei Turroni, he studied singing and got his bachelor's degree as a musicologist at the Department of Art and Music at Bologna State University. He then established himself as a lyrical tenor. At the age of 38 he gave up performing because of his health troubles, and started writing novels. He currently lives between Bologna and Milan.
